Build a multi-page website for "Artisan Goods Co.",
a handmade crafts shop. I need:
- Homepage with a hero banner, featured products
  section, and a newsletter signup
- Product catalog page with category filters
  (pottery, textiles, woodwork, jewelry) and a grid
  of product cards with images, names, and prices
- About page with our story, team member profiles
  with photos, and a mission statement
- Shared navigation header and footer across all
  pages
Use React Router for page navigation. Products
should be fetched from an API endpoint.

I'll build the complete Artisan Goods Co. website. Let me start all Phase 1 tasks in parallel.Now let me run all Phase 1 tasks in parallel — images, fonts, colors, and logo generation:Phase 1 complete. Now let me also get a few more product images and build Phase 2 in parallel:Now let me build everything in Phase 2 in parallel — the API, Header, and Footer:Now register the API route in entry.ts:Now let me verify the API works, then build all three pages in parallel:API is live. Now let me mark that done and build all three pages simultaneously:Now building all three pages in parallel:Now update routes.tsx and the RootLayout meta description:Now update the SEO routes and verify everything is working:Now let me verify the pages load and check for any errors:All APIs are working perfectly, no errors. Let me mark all remaining todos complete:All 5/5 tasks complete. The Artisan Goods Co. website is fully built — here's what's live:

**Homepage** — Full-bleed hero with "Crafted with Care, Made to Last," featured products pulled from the API with loading skeletons, a craft story section, and a newsletter signup with a dark walnut background.

**Product Catalog** (`/products`) — Category filter chips (All, Pottery, Textiles, Woodwork, Jewelry), a responsive 3-column grid with staggered entrance animations on filter change, product count, and loading skeletons while fetching.

**About Page** (`/about`) — Full-bleed hero, 2-column brand story with asymmetric layout, a large pull-quote mission statement on a dark background, a values section, and team profiles with circular photos.

**Shared Header** — Sticky with backdrop blur on scroll, logo left, nav links with animated underline hover, terracotta "Shop Now" CTA, and a mobile hamburger menu.

**Shared Footer** — Dark walnut background, 3-column layout with brand blurb, navigation links, contact info, and social icons (Instagram, Pinterest, Facebook).

**Products API** — Express endpoint at `/api/products` supporting `?category=` and `?featured=true` filters, serving 12 products across all four categories.

input.prompt:
Build a complete multi-page website for "Artisan Goods Co.", a handmade crafts shop. This is a full build — not just a homepage preview — covering all pages listed below.

PROJECT DETAILS:
- Business: Artisan Goods Co. — handmade crafts shop
- Categories: Pottery, Textiles, Woodwork, Jewelry
- Pages needed: Homepage, Product Catalog, About
- Data: Products fetched from an Express API endpoint

DESIGN DIRECTION:
Warm, artisanal aesthetic that feels handcrafted and authentic — like a beloved local market stall elevated to a premium boutique. Rich earthy tones with generous whitespace. Photography-forward with organic textures. Should feel inviting and trustworthy, not corporate or generic.

LAYOUT TYPE: Standard
Full header navigation and footer across all pages.

VISUAL DIRECTION:
- Color: Warm earthy palette — terracotta, warm cream/off-white, deep walnut brown, sage green accent. NOT stark white or generic blue. Warm off-white (#FAF7F2 range) as base background.
- Typography: Elegant serif for headings (Playfair Display or similar), clean humanist sans for body (Lato or similar). Generous line-height, warm and readable.
- Layout: Full-bleed hero with warm overlay. Product grid with generous spacing. NO icon grids. Asymmetric section layouts where possible.
- Visual elements: Photography-forward. Use Getty stock images for hero (artisan workshop, handmade pottery, textiles), product cards, and team photos. Subtle organic texture overlays.
- Motion: Subtle — fade-in on scroll for sections, gentle hover lift on product cards (translate-y + shadow), smooth nav transitions.

LOGO:
Use the media-logo skill to generate a logo for "Artisan Goods Co." — a warm, handcrafted mark with artisan feel. Place in header and footer.

MOTION DESIGN:
- Level: Subtle
- Effects: Fade-in on scroll (400ms ease-out), hover lift on product cards (translateY -4px + shadow deepens, 200ms), smooth underline hover on nav links, newsletter button hover fill (200ms)
- Personality: Warm and unhurried — nothing snappy or corporate

SECTION-SPECIFIC:

Hero (Homepage):
- Full-bleed image of an artisan workshop or handmade goods with warm gradient overlay
- Headline: "Crafted with Care, Made to Last" — large serif, warm cream color
- Subheadline: "Discover handmade goods from independent artisans"
- Two CTAs: "Shop Now" (primary, terracotta) and "Our Story" (ghost/outline)
- Subtle fade-in entrance animation

Featured Products (Homepage):
- Section title: "Featured Pieces"
- 4 product cards in a 2x2 or 4-column grid (desktop), pulled from /api/products?featured=true
- Cards: product image, name, category badge, price — gentle hover lift
- "View All Products" link below

Newsletter Signup (Homepage):
- Warm background section (terracotta or deep brown)
- Headline: "Join Our Maker Community"
- Single email input + "Subscribe" button
- Asymmetric layout, not centered-on-band

Product Catalog Page (/products):
- Page title + category filter tabs/chips: All | Pottery | Textiles | Woodwork | Jewelry
- Responsive product grid (3 cols desktop, 2 tablet, 1 mobile)
- Each card: product image, name, category badge, price
- Products fetched from /api/products?category={category} (or all if no filter)
- Staggered card entrance animation on filter change
- Loading skeleton state while fetching

About Page (/about):
- Hero section: full-bleed image with "Our Story" headline
- Brand story: 2-column layout (text left, image right) — warm, personal narrative about handmade craft values
- Mission statement: large pull-quote style, centered, distinctive typography
- Team section: 3 team member cards with photo, name, role, short bio
- Photos from Getty stock (artisans at work)

Shared Header:
- Logo left, nav links center/right: Home | Products | About
- Sticky on scroll with subtle background blur
- Mobile hamburger menu
- Style: warm cream background, walnut brown text, terracotta hover

Shared Footer:
- Multi-column: Brand blurb + logo | Navigation links | Contact info
- Warm dark background (deep walnut/charcoal brown)
- Cream text
- Social icons (Instagram, Pinterest, Facebook — artisan brands)

DIFFERENTIATION:
Full-bleed photography sections with warm gradient overlays that break the vertical rhythm. Serif/sans type pairing creates editorial feel. Product cards with category color-coded badges.

CONSISTENCY:
Maintain warm artisanal energy throughout — footer and about page must feel as intentional as the homepage hero. No design energy drop-off.

BUILD ORDER:

Phase 1 — Setup (run in parallel):
- Search Getty for images: artisan workshop hero, pottery close-up, textile weaving, woodworking, jewelry making, team/artisan portraits (at least 8 images total)
- Set font stack using fontTheme tool: Playfair Display (headings) + Lato (body)
- Set color scheme using colorScheme tool: terracotta primary, warm cream background, walnut brown foreground, sage green accent
- Generate logo using media-logo skill for "Artisan Goods Co."

Phase 2 — API + Structure (run in parallel after Phase 1):
- Build Express API endpoint: GET /api/products — returns array of 12 products across 4 categories (pottery, textiles, woodwork, jewelry), each with id, name, category, price, description, imageUrl, featured flag. Use real Getty image URLs from Phase 1 for imageUrl fields. Support ?category= and ?featured=true query params.
- Build Header (src/layouts/parts/Header.tsx): sticky, logo left, nav links, mobile menu, warm cream bg
- Build Footer (src/layouts/parts/Footer.tsx): multi-column, dark warm bg, social icons

Phase 3 — Pages (after Phase 1 & 2 complete, run in parallel):
- Build Homepage (src/pages/index.tsx): hero, featured products (fetch from API), newsletter signup
- Build Product Catalog (src/pages/products.tsx): category filters, product grid, fetch from API with category param, loading skeletons
- Build About page (src/pages/about.tsx): story, mission statement, team profiles

Phase 4 — Routes + Finalize:
- Update src/routes.tsx to add /products and /about routes
- Mark all todo items as COMPLETE using the todoList tool
- Show the finished site

ROUTES TO ADD (src/routes.tsx):
```tsx
{ path: '/products', element: <ProductsPage /> }
{ path: '/about', element: <AboutPage /> }
```

API SHAPE (src/server/api/products.ts, imported + registered in src/server/entry.ts):
```ts
GET /api/products
  ?category=pottery|textiles|woodwork|jewelry  (optional)
  ?featured=true  (optional)
Response: { products: Product[] }

Product: {
  id: string,
  name: string,
  category: 'pottery' | 'textiles' | 'woodwork' | 'jewelry',
  price: number,  // e.g. 48.00
  description: string,
  imageUrl: string,
  featured: boolean
}
```

TODO LIST IDs (mark complete when done):

- Product catalog page: 1780033501953-96viyy4
- About page: 1780033501954-oi95z43
- Products API endpoint: 1780033501954-3lukzwr
- Shared header & footer: 1780033501954-lbgcfnf

INITIAL SCOPE: Build ALL pages and features as described — this is a full site build, not a preview.

turns.content: The product catalog page looks good, but I want to make sure the product data isn't just hardcoded directly in the component. Can you confirm the catalog page is pulling products from the API endpoint or a separate service module, not just listing them inline in the JSX?

The catalog page is already pulling from the API — not hardcoded in JSX. Here's exactly how it works:

In `src/pages/products.tsx`, a `useEffect` fetches from `/api/products` (with an optional `?category=` filter) whenever the active category changes:

```ts
fetch(url)
  .then((r) => r.json())

```
